condition.notes: Input MOSFET has been confirmed off (voltage present at drain but missing at ACIN) and charger VCC has not been confirmed good. Check the charger's logic supply next.

next_steps.action: Measure the charger IC VCC pin (logic supply, typically 3.3 V from +3VALW).

measure.expected: 3.3 V typical; some chargers derive VCC from ACIN via an internal LDO.
measure.safety: Charger IC pins are dense; use fine probes.

interpretations.then: Charger logic supply is good. Proceed to check charger enable / SMBus state.
+3VALW is dead. The charger IC has no logic supply and cannot drive the input MOSFET. Diagnose +3VALW first.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need charger datasheet for VCC pin and expected voltage.
